      - text: Highest interest ₹3,750.00 (Month 1) Lowest interest ₹77.26 (Month 60) Principal each month Increases steadily End of loan Outstanding ₹0.00
      - article:
        - heading "4. UNDERSTAND THE RULE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: "EMI for a loan is given by the annuity formula:"
        - strong:
          - text: EMI = P × r(1+r)
          - superscript: "n"
          - text: / ((1+r)
          - superscript: "n"
          - text: "-1)"
        - paragraph: P = loan principal r = monthly rate = annual rate/(12×100) n = total payments = years×12
        - complementary:
          - text: Key idea
          - paragraph: Each EMI is constant, but the interest part decreases and the principal part increases over time.
      - article:
        - heading "5. WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: "Given: P=₹5,00,000, annual rate=9%, tenure=5 years"
        - paragraph: r=0.09/12=0.0075, n=5×12=60
        - strong: = ₹10,379.18
